value.thesis: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra highlighted a blowout quarter with 26 strategic customer agreements stretching to 2031 and tighter supply in 2027-2028 on CNBC's Squawk on the Street, suggesting strong demand visibility.

John Kartsonas, founder and managing partner at Breakwave Partners, discussed managing the world's top performing ETF of 2026 (BWET) while understanding geopolitical shipping activity in the Strait of Hormuz on Bloomberg Surveillance.
David Rosenberg discussed the ROSY ETF on Macro Voices, though his specific view on the fund's outlook was not explicitly detailed in the excerpt.
Steve Eisman on The Real Eisman Playbook is shorting FICO due to concerns about off-balance sheet financing and accounting practices in the AI era.
Meb Faber on The Meb Faber Show highlights Cambria Shareholder Yield ETF for disciplined exposure to companies returning cash through dividends and buybacks.
Meb Faber on The Meb Faber Show discusses Cambria Foreign Shareholder Yield ETF as part of the shareholder yield suite emphasizing global dividend and buyback discipline.
Meb Faber on The Meb Faber Show includes Cambria Emerging Shareholder Yield ETF in the shareholder yield suite for emerging market exposure focused on cash returns.
Meb Faber on The Meb Faber Show presents Cambria Micro & SmallCap Shareholder Yield ETF as part of the shareholder yield discipline across market capitalizations.
Meb Faber on The Meb Faber Show features Cambria Large Cap Shareholder Yield ETF in the shareholder yield strategy emphasizing large-cap dividend and buyback discipline.
Bill Ackman on The Knowledge Project sold Netflix and later bought it back, demonstrating his evolving conviction in the company despite past skepticism about innovation vs. hype.
Jensen Huang on Squawk Box discussed NVIDIA's open agent safety platform and share buyback program, signaling confidence in the company's AI leadership position.
Atlassian CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes on Decoder noted that MCP users are expanding Atlassian spend twice as fast and the company is reshaping around AI opportunities.
Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince on Decoder highlighted the company's positioning around bots overtaking human traffic and innovative HTTP 402 pay-per-crawl model.
Cisco's Head of IR Sam Badri on The Real Eisman Playbook reported growth accelerating from 5% to 18% and strong positioning with hyperscalers in AI infrastructure.
MongoDB Interim CEO Dev Ittycheria on Squawk on the Street discussed the company's competitive positioning and search for a successor following CJ Desai's departure to Meta.
Micron's upcoming earnings discussed on The Deep End featured gross margins near 85% and $100B of strategic customer agreements amid cyclical market dynamics.

Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure Amin Vahdat on Training Data podcast highlighted Google's competitive advantages in AI data center infrastructure, TPU design, and co-design with DeepMind, suggesting confidence in GOOG's AI infrastructure leadership.

Thomas Wolf on MTS discussed NVIDIA's $12.93B acquisition of Hugging Face and enterprise adoption of open-weights models, indicating strong demand for NVIDIA's AI capabilities and ecosystem expansion.
CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz on CNBC's Squawk on the Street discussed AI safety and agents as a new attack surface, positioning the company at the forefront of AI-related cybersecurity needs.
Nokia CEO Justin Hotard on CNBC's The Tech Download discussed Nokia's role in AI data-center networking and AI-ready mobile networks as customers face power and supply constraints.

CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator highlighted Cognition as the first production customer on Vera Rubin, demonstrating strong demand for the company's data center infrastructure and GPU compute services, per CNBC's Squawk on the Street.

SAP CEO Christian Klein indicated that the company maintains a competitive moat as AI models improve, with enterprise software still critical for mission-critical business tasks, per Big Technology Podcast.

John Kartsonas, founder and managing partner at Breakwave Partners, noted that his firm is managing the world's top performing ETF of 2026 (BWET) while analyzing geopolitical activity in the Strait of Hormuz, per Bloomberg Surveillance.
Spotify co-founder Daniel Ek discussed the company's position on open versus closed AI models and compute regulation concerns, per All-In podcast.
